descriptor: Task×Representation Interaction Tensor Reconstruction, Operator-Specific Difficulty Reversal, Low-Rank Interaction Basis, Fresh-Task Predictive Transport & Hosted-Inference Measurement-Law Locality

theoretical_reframing.rejected: A task-independent representation-difficulty field externalizes across task families.
theoretical_reframing.promoted: Measurement difficulty is primarily relational, D(task,representation), but P56 does not tell us whether that interaction is structured or idiosyncratic.
theoretical_reframing.central_question: Does the surviving task×representation interaction lie near a reusable low-dimensional representation basis that predicts unseen representation vertices in fresh tasks, or is it genuinely task-local?

interface.rationale: P55 established current GPT-OSS point access. P53 already supplies a nearly complete three-task GPT-OSS interaction tensor; P57 can therefore test same-model fresh-task transport without substituting for the unavailable Gemini estimand.
interface.gemini: DORMANT; no Gemini calls and no cross-model inheritance.

historical_training_tensor.source: P55 canonical artifact / original P53 GPT-OSS rows
historical_training_tensor.rule: Every historical-basis claim must survive both admissible training worlds. No probability is assigned to either world.

FAULT_DIAGNOSIS_HISTORY.object: Two diagnostic traces end in the same terminal code; the admissible u1 challenge may depend on fault history or be history-invariant.

NORMALIZATION_PIPELINE.object: Two data products end in the same normalized summary; the admissible u1 challenge may depend on normalization pipeline or be pipeline-invariant.

MATERIAL_PRECONDITIONING.object: Two material samples end in the same terminal measured state; the admissible u1 challenge may depend on preconditioning history or be history-invariant.

tensor_definition.tau: For each fresh task/block/vertex, tau is the first t<=32 at which the individual alpha=.05 beta-mixture confidence-sequence width for joint valid∧null success reaches 0.50; tau=33 if unresolved.
tensor_definition.interaction: For a task×vertex tau matrix T, Gamma_tv = T_tv - task_mean_t - vertex_mean_v + grand_mean.
tensor_definition.historical_basis: For each of the two historical training worlds, compute the nonzero right-singular subspace of Gamma_old. With three historical tasks its dimension is at most two.
tensor_definition.fresh_residual: For each fresh task/block, x(v)=tau(v)-mean_v(tau)-beta_old(v), where beta_old is the historical representation main-effect profile in the corresponding training world.

frozen_vertex_split.purpose: Estimate fresh-task basis coefficients only on anchors, then predict unseen representation vertices.

fresh_block_reproducibility.statistic: Pearson correlation between fresh task A and B residual interaction profiles after subtracting their block means.

historical_subspace_transport.statistic: Projection-energy fraction of each fresh task×block residual onto the frozen historical interaction basis.
historical_subspace_transport.training_ambiguity: Compute in both historical worlds; primary statistic is the minimum and primary p is the maximum across worlds.
historical_subspace_transport.null: 5000 vertex-label permutations of the fresh residual profile.

anchor_to_holdout_prediction.statistic: Fit historical-basis coefficients using only 8 frozen anchor vertices, then measure MSE improvement over zero-interaction baseline on 24 holdout vertices.
anchor_to_holdout_prediction.training_ambiguity: Compute in both historical worlds; primary statistic is the minimum and primary p is the maximum across worlds.
anchor_to_holdout_prediction.null: 5000 common permutations of historical basis columns before anchor fit and holdout prediction.

primary_tests.multiplicity: 15 primary tests total in one Holm FWER=0.05 family.
primary_tests.full_gate: All 15 primary statistics positive and Holm-rejected.

operator_reversal.definition: For each task/block and each operator R/F/H/T/L, average tau(on)-tau(off) across the 16 Boolean-cube edges for that operator.
operator_reversal.reversal: A strict sign change between tasks/blocks; zero effects are not counted as reversals.
operator_reversal.authority: Descriptive mechanistic readout only; no post-hoc magnitude threshold.

expanded_tensor_outputs.object: Historical 3-task tensor plus each fresh A/B block separately.
outputs: exact numerical rank under standard SVD tolerance
expanded_tensor_outputs.caution: Low exact rank alone is not evidence; predictive holdout transport is the constitutive test.

verdict_logic.technical: All 12288 exact-schema calls required; otherwise TECHNICAL_HOLD and only failed calls may be replayed.
verdict_logic.subspace_only: All 3 block-reproducibility and all 6 subspace tests pass, but at least one anchor→holdout prediction test fails.
verdict_logic.prediction_only: All 3 block-reproducibility and all 6 prediction tests pass, but at least one subspace test fails.
verdict_logic.partial: At least one test in each of block-reproducibility, subspace, and prediction families passes after Holm, but no stronger branch applies.
verdict_logic.reversal_locality: No transport branch applies and at least one strict operator-effect sign reversal occurs across fresh tasks.
verdict_logic.unstructured: No stronger branch and no strict reversal.

killed: Low-rank matrix/tensor factorization is prior art.
Multi-task low-rank representation learning is prior art.
ANOVA/generalizability decomposition of task×method interactions is prior art.
Prompt-interaction analysis is prior art, including recent interaction-based prompt-sensitivity work.
Holdout prediction from a learned basis is not itself novel.
novelty_kill.surviving_candidate: A prospective measurement-science test in which a task×representation interaction object, promoted only after a universal field failed, must reproduce across independent randomization blocks and predict unseen representation vertices of fresh tasks from a basis frozen on prior tasks.

literature_pressure: Low-rank multi-task factorization and matrix/tensor decomposition literature.
Qin et al. (2026), Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions.
P51–P56 EPISTEME lineage as the prospectively generated explanandum.
frozen_rules: No historical GPT-OSS tau imputation: both training worlds are retained.
No basis dimension tuning after fresh outcomes.
Anchor/holdout split is fixed by canonical vertex index before outcomes.
Cross-task interaction transport and universal representation-field claims remain distinct.
No provider-internal or neural mechanism inference.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P57.
